item.title: Takaoka Copperware: A Hands-On Metalworking Craft Experience — Guide
item.description: Takaoka has produced copperware and bronze casting for over 400 years, a tradition dating back to the early Edo period when the local feudal lord invited metalworking craftsmen to the area, and the industry remains active today, producing everything from temple bells to fine decorative objects. Visitors can try hands-on workshops in the city’s craft district, working under the guidance of local artisans to shape, polish or finish their own small copperware piece to take home as a souvenir of the experience.
